chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm narrated from his father, from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the Friday prayer, and he said: It is obligatory upon one who is at a distance of two farsakhs from it; but if he is farther than that, then nothing is incumbent upon him.

key_terms.رَأْسِ فَرْسَخَيْنِ: the limit of two farsakhs in distance

ai.seo_question: At what distance does Jumuʿah prayer become non-obligatory according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the obligation of Jumuʿah prayer based on distance. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that Jumuʿah is obligatory for one who is within two farsakhs, while one beyond that distance is not obligated.
